name: core.openwop.workflows.csm-ops
description: CSM↔CRM linkage workflows (ADR 0212, RFC 0013). Where feature.csm.agents.health-insights is read-only, these two chains carry the CSM write surface: computing an Account's healthScore/healthFactors from its linked CRM company's deals/tasks (the scoring recipe as visible, editable workflow configuration rather than buried code — ADR 0212 §3), and a human-gated renewal-risk follow-up over the deal-hygiene shape (ADR 0212 §4 — renewals are deals, not a new entity). All tenant/org-specific values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). Resolves on hosts that ship the feature.crm + feature.csm features + node packs (the OpenWOP reference app).
author: openwop

chains.label: Compute Health From CRM
chains.description: ADR 0212 §3 — reads the linked CRM company's open deals (feature.crm.nodes.list-deals, company-scoped) and the org's open tasks (feature.crm.nodes.list-tasks — CRM has no company filter for tasks server-side, so the health-write node re-filters locally by companyId), then hands both lists to feature.csm.nodes.health-set, which applies its documented default formula (100, minus a configurable number of points per open deal and per open task, clamped to [0,100]) to produce healthScore + an inspectable healthFactors breakdown. Bind to a schedule or run on demand per account; tune the formula by editing the health-write node's `weights` config directly — no code change needed. Requires the target Account's crmRef to already point at orgId/companyId (set via the CSM UI or POST/PATCH /csm/accounts).

orgId.description: The org the linked CRM company belongs to.

companyId.description: The linked CRM company (Account.crmRef.companyId) whose deals/tasks feed the score.

accountId.description: The csm Account to update. Its crmRef MUST already reference orgId/companyId.

account.description: The csm Account after the write — healthScore, healthFactors, and healthComputedAt.

chains.label: Renewal Risk Review
chains.description: ADR 0212 §4 — renewals are deals, not a new entity: reads an org's open deals, then pauses at a human review gate (the deal-hygiene shape) for the CSM/account team to flag which are at renewal risk — this chain does not attempt to infer risk itself. On approval, creates one follow-up task. Pair with a weekly or monthly scheduled trigger per account book; the run feed is the audit trail.

orgId.description: The org whose open deals (the renewal book) to review.

config.title: Review open deals — flag any at renewal risk for follow-up

task.description: The follow-up task created after the reviewer confirms a renewal is at risk.
